title: $2,000 Cashback or Accessory Credit on BYD Atto 2 Premium $35,990 + On-Road Costs @ BYD
body:
Deal: $2,000 Cashback or Accessory Credit on BYD Atto 2 Premium $35,990 + On-Road Costs @ BYD

[shxhshzhz] ~$37k driveaway after cashback. Why get this instead of:
Larger Jaecoo J5 EV SUV with more range for the same price
Saving $8000 and getting the BYD Dolphin EV with similar range
GWM Ora 5 EV SUV $33,990 driveaway
[Lizard Spock] Do the other car companies guarantee that they will build my dream? But in all seriousness, no, no they don't.
[noisymime] But you can Build Your Dreams WITH a Dolphin! If you're Dreams aren't better with a Dolphin, then I'm sorry sir but we just can't be friends.
[Tyler Kwok] I personally think geely ex5 is also a bettery option.
[shxhshzhz] Yes. This price for a small Atto 2 with only 345km range is not competitive and not a deal compared to other options that are cheaper, larger and have more range
[posilepton] Also, competitors generally have more features on their base model, while BYD locks many of them behind their premium upgrade.
[Lizard Spock] bettery
I see what you, inadvertently, did there.
[posilepton] Not just that, the other brands are actually flexible on pricing. BYD is one of the worst in terms of haggling the price down. You can get the Ora 5 or GAC Aion UT down to around $30k for far, far better specs.
[AE] Driven all three and yes on paper they look better …a little. driving it, sitting in it, interacting with the car, whole different story. The ATTO 2 wins.
Also wish BYD would be more negotiable, unfortunately they know they have a winner and the cars are selling. I would prefer it to be 25k.
But it could be worse…35k euro overseas and it's even selling it that price.
[posilepton] It's subjective. Having test driven all three, hard disagree on BYD. I'm pretty surprised anyone thinks they're superior in any objective way. Tech on the base BYD is rudimentary and has fewer features than the other two. Interiors on the other two are also much more comfy, with the UT being significantly roomier in feel. You also have far more customisation options where they are minimal for BYD.
BYD is selling based on brand and recognition, they are much larger than the other brands by far and don't really care too much about price penetration or value proposition at this point, both in Australia and in China.
Don't know why you're comparing on Euro prices. They have tariffs on top of existing duties to protect their indigenous car industries. We have no extra taxes on Chinese EVs.
[team teri] @posilepton: BYD is very much into buying market share. But not with every grade of every model. Why would they? In the end they too, like any business, have to maximise profits.
[AE] @posilepton: I'm comparing euro prices just to show that the car is selling at an even higher price in comparable western markets.
And maybe it's not just brand recognition but also a pretty good product. At that price cars aren't very exciting they need to be well rounded, practical and somewhat affordable and I and clearly a lot of other EV buyers think that BYD is doing something right. I 100% agree that they should be cheaper, but gwm or gac aren't the alternative right now.
Sometimes simpler is better. I just need 1 option that works really well and not 10 that works half as good, or come with annoying beeps and bongs that have to be turned off every single time I start the car.
It is subjective and everybody can have an opinion, but you are wrong.😉
[sinosoar] Paid full price in Apr and picked the car at end of June, happy with the car itself so far, just strange feeling when see these discounts or drive away price now. Plus, the dealer never answer my question after car picked up and 5 stars given in Google.
[Lizard Spock] Leave a 1 star review and watch how quickly they answer your question.
[Buddy195] Clearing old stock for the new models. Wish they had something with better range with these reductions. Sub 450km isn’t for me.
[Kanjus] Atto 3 should come down soon with new evo models
[King Tightarse] There is a new Atto 2 on the way with better range and multiple improvements
[AE] As with everything in life there is always something better around the corner. Buy one if you need one. We needed a 2nd car and actually bought an atto 2 premium. We've tried a lot of similar priced models +-10k but they all felt less refined. It's one of the least annoying (beeping) cars tested and it's very easy to cover the driver camera. For us the ATTO 2 ticks all the boxes and can't wait to get it.
[deneb] You might have a deal if stacking with the 5% novated lease discount.
[paloverde88] sneak peek in Dec the atto 3 2028 back to the future edition
[Spacexyz] EV deals without mentioning the RANGE will be considered as 200km max range by default😅.
